{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Lunatic Fringer''''' was a [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] that was used by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keb Nevrunn]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

{{RPG}}
In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]], a friend of Nevrunn, arranged for the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to transport the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who were making a delivery for [[Renna's Transport Service]]. However, while the ''Fringer'' was returning from the assignment, the ship became caught in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] due to the actions of a [[shadow creature]], which was draining passing starships of power.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lunatic Fringer'' appears in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philosophy|Philosophy]]'', and is loaned to the players&mdash;who role-play as the Heroes of Cularin&mdash;if the player characters do not own a starship of their own and do not have the skills to fly one.
